label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: all complete True, pending max 6.0, failures 0, server errors 0.0, pool timeouts 0, other edges 0

A.rule: no failed deliveries and pending stayed low

report.summary: In the window, delivery was healthy: arrivals matched publications and all 733 attempts succeeded in about 71 ms. A static FAILED row (619, ~10.6 h old) predates the window.

findings.claim: Outbox kept pace with arrivals; pending stayed at 2-6 and arrivals minus publications was -2, so no backlog.
findings.reason: Counts are settled and per-bucket publications track arrivals.

findings.claim: All 733 delivery attempts succeeded on attempt 1 with p95 about 73 ms, almost all of it consumer auth time.
findings.reason: There were zero errors and no retries, and the timings are tight.

findings.claim: No DB pool or lock contention: zero acquisition timeouts, zero pending borrowers, zero blocked sessions.
findings.reason: The pool and blocker samples show no contention.

findings.claim: A constant 619 failed rows exist with oldest undelivered age of about 38,000 s; they predate the window and did not change during it.
findings.reason: The failed count was flat at 619 and the oldest age grew exactly with wall-clock time.

limitations: The window is only 210 s and does not cover when customers saw the delay.
There is no data on why the 619 rows failed, or on the config revision marked dirty.
next_checks: Inspect the 619 FAILED outbox rows: failure times, error causes and affected customers.
Re-run the diagnosis over the period when customers reported delays, and check downstream delivery.

alternatives.reason: The rows exist, but the evidence does not show when or why they failed, or whether they match the complaints.
alternatives.hypothesis: Old permanently FAILED outbox rows (about 10 h old) were never delivered and are the late notifications customers saw.

alternatives.reason: Only LedgerCore-to-consumer timing in this 3.5-minute window was observed.
alternatives.hypothesis: Lateness occurs downstream of the consumer, or in an earlier period.
